note: Every recorded MiR base move of run 14 (round 9: run 13's recording to the end of F53, F54 on re-planned): pivot, drive along the heading, pivot (mir_route.py). Each MiR docks heading +x; a move toward +x is one forward drive; a move toward -x of at most 0.5 m is a straight reverse (the docking leg); a longer one turns round at a clear spot (pivot 90 deg away from the bench, 130 mm out, pivot 90 deg), drives back along the return lane and turns in at a clear spot at or behind the dock. Every pose of every leg (pivots every 2 deg, straight legs every 20 mm) was checked with FCL for the MiR body, cabinet, mounting plate, tool stand, screw presenter and the parked arm with its tool and anything it held, against the bench, fixtures and nests, the trunnion, the machine parts in the cell, the other MiR and its arm where the recording has them, and the long table's top, legs, stretchers (round 9: a cross rail at each leg pair), nests, trays and the items still on it (round 9: a hose or line as the box of its coil, as it is drawn).
